english.title: Unauthorised disclosure of information - Identity Cards Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority made a disclosure of information that you were required to keep confidential under the provisions of section 27 of the Identity Cards Act 2006

(A)_[by providing another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), with that information]_
(B)_[by **(..SPECIFY THE WAY IN WHICH INFORMATION WAS DISCLOSED..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 27(1) and (5) of the Identity Cards Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without lawful authority
provided another person with/otherwise disclosed
information that was confidential under section 27(2) of the Identity Cards Act 2006

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For the current legislation, please see the Identity Documents Act 2010.
(ii) Section 27(3) of the Identity Cards Act 2006 sets out when information is provided or otherwise disclosed with lawful authority.
(iii) Section 27(4) of the Identity Cards Act 2006 provides a defence to this offence.

other.penalty:
Two years imprisonment and/or fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
